Dream Builder Program Global Hackathon 2026
  • Sign In

Global Hackathon 2026

Saturday, 12 September 2026, 10:00 – 17:00 (GMT+8)
Anyone
Session Details
12 Sep 2026 10:00 - 17:00
Program Details

Deadline :
 12 Sep 2026 17:00

Enquiry Email :
 ecenter@ust.hk

Organised by :
 AI Tinkerers Hong Kong

The hackathon challenges participants to build functional AI agents integrated with different tools, bots and channels, bringing together AI builders from around the world. Participants can build individually or in teams, experiment with emerging AI technologies, and connect with a global community of developers, founders and innovators. Open to HKUST Students, Alumni and Staff interested in AI, technology and innovation.

EVENT TIME: Saturday, 12 September 2026, 10:00 – 17:00 (GMT+8)
EVENT VENUE: Hong Kong (venue details provided upon acceptance)
EVENT FORMAT: In-person
LANGUAGE: English
RECOMMENDED FOR: Students, Alumni and Staff interested in AI, software development, entrepreneurship and innovation
REGISTRATION DEADLINE: Apply ASAP — spaces are limited

Register to attend: https://hong-kong.aitinkerers.org/p/agents-everywhere-bots-channels-more-global-hackathon

ORGANIZER: AI Tinkerers Hong Kong

Rundown Details
TimeWhat happens
10:00–10:30Doors, food, check-in, and meeting potential teammates
10:30–11:00Shared global opening and starter-kit walkthrough
11:00–11:15Team formation (Suggested team size: 1-5)
11:15–15:30Build session (Food and Drink will be provided around 12 PM)
15:30–16:30Local show-and-tell (Support Team Hong Kong)
16:30–17:00Submit and wrap (Local Prizes and Photo Opportunities)
